Name: Mines Decor
Author: Luminte
Description:
[size=3]The Mines Furniture Catalogue can be purchased at Robin's for 25,000g. It contains a variety of mines based furniture! The Wallpaper and Flooring can be found in the normal Catalogue

For a matching mines themed Farmhouse, check out my other mod: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/42864](AT) Seasonal Mines Farmhouse[/url][/size]

Downloads.Description: Fixed a naming issue for the dwarf chests, Added Calcifer as a Requirement(I forgot to add it lol), and changed the collision of minecarts to be 2x1 instead of 2x2 so they're 1 tile tall.

Manifest.Description: Adds some Mines themed Wallpaper, Flooring, and Decor.
